name: e-print-client
description: Local silent printing client for e-print.
author: E-Print Team

scripts.dist:win:uat: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=uat&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:prod: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=prod&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:all: npm run dist:win:uat && npm run dist:win:prod
scripts.dist:win:uat:portable: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=uat&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win portable
scripts.dist:win:prod:portable: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=prod&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win portable
scripts.pack:win:uat: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=uat&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win dir
scripts.pack:win:prod: set E_PRINT_BUILD_ENV=prod&& set CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&& electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win dir
